description: Erection of a single storey rear wrapround extension following demolition of the existing wraparound conservatory
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Unnumbered site plan; 149-EXT-01; 149-EXT-02; 149-EXT-04 and 149-EXT-05 received: 21 June 2019
149-EXT-03 received: 10 July 2019
Amended Drawings 149-PROP-04; 149-PROP-05; received: 30 July 2019
Amended Drawing 149-PROP-06 received: 19 August 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
